component.name: Homeworld Infection
component.summary: Homeworld: Cataclysm on a native recreation of its engine

description.p: Homeworld Infection is a fan recreation of the engine of Homeworld: Cataclysm, built from Relic Entertainment's Homeworld source code (Relic End User License Agreement, non-commercial use only). It plays the game's own files: you need your GOG copy of Homeworld: Emergence, installed or as the offline installer. The first start finds it or asks for it.
